title: Crypto2DevHashCtx.algo field is stored but never read
description: What is awkward: Crypto2DevHashCtx stores a 32-byte algo string (port.c:103-105). It is written once at Init time (port.c:900-901) via XSTRNCPY. It is never read again — Update and Finalize paths use only op_fd and pool_slot. The string is wasted state in every in-flight hash context (32 bytes each). Suggested rewrite: remove the algo field from Crypto2DevHashCtx. The algo string is only needed to pass to INIT ioctl, which happens at allocation time; after that only the fd and slot index matter. This also removes the null-termination boilerplate (port.c:901).
